name: What is included in a typical exterior painting estimate from Discounted Roofing Co.?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical exterior painting estimate from Discounted Roofing Co.?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical exterior painting estimate from Discounted Roofing Co. includes the cost of labor, materials (paint, primer, caulk, etc.), surface preparation (cleaning, scraping, sanding), and protection for non-painted areas. It also covers the cost of any necessary repairs to the surface before painting, such as minor wood rot or crack filling. We provide a detailed breakdown to ensure transparency, outlining each service component and its associated cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our estimates include labor, materials, surface preparation, protection of non-painted areas, and minor repairs.
